description: This file implements the 'git for-each-repo' command, which executes a specified command on multiple repositories defined in a configuration list. It handles command-line options, reads repository paths from configuration, and runs commands within each repository context.

methods.name: int run_command_on_repo(const char * path,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Runs a specified command with arguments in the context of a given repository path. It prepares a child process with the working directory set to the repository and executes the command.

methods.name: int cmd_for_each_repo(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, reads a list of repository paths from configuration, and executes a specified command in each repository. Handles error cases and options such as 'keep-going'.
